name: In The Ember - Yujin zhi Zhong
original_name: In The Ember 余烬之中
source:
Angelina Scarrot, a longtime member of the Adventurers Guild, was assigned an unusual and highly paid mission - to accompany a terminally ill girl on a journey around the world. As they traveled together, a special bond began to form between them...

[Based on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/976060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Angelina Scarrot是冒险者公会的一名资深成员，她接到了一项非同寻常、报酬丰厚的任务：陪伴一位身患绝症的女孩环游世界。旅途中，她们之间逐渐产生了特殊的羁绊……

[改编自：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/976060/]Steam[/url]]
